attributes.board_name: District of Columbia Board of Physical Therapy (DC Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least half of the required hours must be live programs (direct, real-time interaction: lectures, symposia, live teleconferences, live webinars, workshops); live interactive real-time online CE counts as in-person (Board Policy Statement 24-001).
rules.new_licensee_rule: First-time renewal: CE not required. One-time birth-month transition: 50% of CE accepted for licensees with a term shorter than 2 years, but the 2 LGBTQ hours and the 10% public health priorities still apply.
rules.audit_note: CE documents are uploaded in the renewal portal; after renewal licensees may be audited and must submit CE documents to the Board.

topics.who: 10% of required hours on public health priorities named by the DC Health Director (notice effective October 1, 2025)

rules.notes: Biennial; since June 16, 2024 licenses expire the last day of the birth month (odd-year birth year renews in odd years, even in even years). Renewal fee $179 plus $50 name-based background check.
